facts.text: Through the Hawk Promise, eligible Texas freshmen and transfer students from families with incomes up to $100,000 can have tuition and mandatory fees covered.

sources.title: Hawk Promise | Grants at University of Houston-Clear Lake

facts.text: First-time college applicants to UHCL receive assured admission with a high school GPA of 3.0 or higher.
